# ONNX Runtime notices

Copied without modification from Microsoft's ONNX Runtime `v1.20.0` tag:

- https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/blob/v1.20.0/LICENSE
- https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/blob/v1.20.0/ThirdPartyNotices.txt

The Android module resolves `com.microsoft.onnxruntime:onnxruntime-android:1.20.0@aar`
from Maven Central, verifies its SHA-256 and packages only its ARM64/x86_64 C runtime
libraries. These notices accompany them in APK assets. No prebuilt personal binary
is committed here.
